chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Ibn Faḍḍāl, from Yūnus ibn Yaʿqūb, from Manṣūr ibn Ḥāzim, who said:

I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: I performed the obligatory prayer, but I forgot to recite throughout my entire prayer. He said: Have you not completed the bowing and the prostration? I said: Yes. He said: Then your prayer has been completed, if it was out of forgetfulness.

key_terms.تَمَّتْ: has been completed and is valid

ai.seo_question: Is the obligatory prayer valid if someone forgets the recitation entirely?
ai.summary: This hadith states that if a person forgets the recitation in the obligatory prayer, the prayer remains valid so long as the rukūʿ and sujūd were completed. It establishes a legal ruling concerning forgetfulness in salat and indicates that unintentional omission does not invalidate the prayer in this case.
